name: Arnold Shoulder Press
instructionStepsEn: Very common shoulder exercise.
As shown here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vj2w851ZHRM

name: Bent Over Rowing Reverse
instructionStepsEn: The same as regular rowing, but holding a reversed grip (your palms pointing forwards):

Grab the barbell with a wide grIp (slightly more than shoulder wide) and lean forward. Your upper body is not quite parallel to the floor, but forms a slight angle. The chest's out during the whole exercise.
Pull now the barbell with a fast movement towards your belly button, not further up. Go slowly down to the initial position. Don't swing with your body and keep your arms next to your body.

name: Burpees
instructionStepsEn: Jump, lay down on your chest, do a pushup then jump, repeat

name: Calf Raises on Hackenschmitt Machine
instructionStepsEn: Place yourself on the machine with your back firmly against the backrest, the feet are on the platform for calf raises. Check that the feet are half free and that you can completely stretch the calf muscles down.
With straight knees pull up your weight as much as you can. Go with a fluid movement down till the calves are completely stretched. Repeat.

name: Full Sit Outs
instructionStepsEn: (A) Get in high plank position on your hands and toes.(B) Shift your weight to your left hand as you turn your body to the right; bend your right leg behind you and extend your right arm up. Return to the center and repeat on the opposite side. Continue, alternating sides. Make it easier: Don’t raise your arm after you bend your leg behind you. Make it harder: Balance with your arm and leg extended for two counts.

name: Hip Raise, Lying
instructionStepsEn: Lying down on your back, with your feet flat on the floor. Raise your hips up evenly as high as you can and hold for as long as you can.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
instructionStepsEn: Use inclined bench. Hold dumbbells straight out to your sides, elbows slightly bent. Bring arms together above you, keeping angle of elbows fixed.

name: Prone Scapular Retraction - Arms at Side
instructionStepsEn: Lying on stomach with head on towel.
Stretch arms straight out to your sides.
Slowly lift your arms, pulling your shoulderblades together, hold for 3 seconds.

name: Rack Deadlift
instructionStepsEn: Deadlift to be done using a Smith machine or a free rack. Bar or barbell hould be just right under the knee cap level. Lift using the glutes and through the heels, then come back to starting postion with a control movement of 2 seconds.
This exercise targets mainly the lower back and glutes.

name: Reverse Plank
instructionStepsEn: Plank with stomach towards ceiling

name: Side Plank
instructionStepsEn: Works your obliques and helps stabilize your spine. Lie on your side and support your body between your forearm and knee to your feet.

name: Straight-arm Pull Down (bar Attachment)
instructionStepsEn: Use the straight bar attachment on a high pulley. Grasp the two ends of the bar with your palms facing downward and your arms straight out in front of you. Pull your hands down towards your hips, while keeping your arms straight, then raise them back up to the starting position.

name: Triceps Extensions on Cable With Bar
instructionStepsEn: Grab the bar, stand with your feet shoulder wide, keep your back straight and lean forward a little. Push the bar down, making sure the elbows don't move during the exercise. Without pause go back to the initial position.

name: Sloper hanging
instructionStepsEn: Hanging on sloper holds of a fingerboard for a amount of seconds

name: Fingerboard 20 mm edge
instructionStepsEn: Hang for 10 seconds on a fingerboard with a 20 mm edge

name: Smith Press
instructionStepsEn: Sitting almost 90 degree angle, smith machine

name: commando pull-ups
instructionStepsEn: variation of the pull-up exercise, it is performed with a grip of one hand supine and one hand prone, do not twist the torso to get back to the front, the head passes once to one side, once to the other.

name: Alternating bicep curls
instructionStepsEn: Bend one arm at the elbow, bringing the dumbbell up to your shoulder. Your upper arm should remain motionless during this movement.
Bring the dumbbell back down until your arm is in its original relaxed position.
Repeat, switching arms.

name: Quadruped thoracic rotation left
instructionStepsEn: On inhale, move your left elbow toward your right hand, keeping your left hand behind your head.
On exhale, move your left elbow to point up toward the ceiling.
Repeat.

name: Bag training
instructionStepsEn: Bag training improves muscle definition of: deltoids; rear deltoids; triceps; biceps, as well as being a great cardio exercise

name: Side bend
instructionStepsEn: With a weight in one hand, extend that arm down and bend the other arm, resting your hand on your head. Now move the hand holding the weight by rotating your torso up and down.

name: Cycling cardio session
instructionStepsEn: Cardio session on a Technogym Bike Excite 1000 stationary bike.

name: Front lever pull-up
instructionStepsEn: in the front lever position, with legs extended or easier if collected, pull by bringing the chest closer to the bar.

name: Pseudo Planche Push-up
instructionStepsEn: You should have the shoulder line in front of your wrists an perform a push-up, maintaining the shoulder in the same position

name: Lower Back Extensions
instructionStepsEn: Engage the muscles
Lift your bottom slightly
Controlled movement
Slow movement
Don't use momentum
Keep your upper body straight

name: Band pull-aparts
instructionStepsEn: Hold the band with your arms extended in front of you at shoulder height.
Keep your elbows slightly bent but fixed throughout the movement.
Pull the band apart by spreading your arms until the band touches or comes close to your chest.
Slowly bring your arms back to the starting position, controlling the tension on the band.

name: Standing Pancake
instructionStepsEn: Stand and open your legs as wide as possible into a straddle position. Then bend at the hips, pushing them back while keeping your back straight.

name: bicycle crunches
instructionStepsEn: Bicycle crunches are a core exercise performed on the floor. Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and legs extended. Lift your shoulders off the ground, bring one knee toward your chest, and twist your torso so your opposite elbow meets the knee. Alternate sides in a pedaling motion, ensuring controlled movements and engaging your core throughout the exercise.

name: Butterfly Sit Up
instructionStepsEn: In
this midrange exercise your arm muscles provide you with a little bit of
momentum to help to get you off the ground. You also open them up in overhead
position which engages the upper back. Start
lying with feet flat on the ground, knees at an angle, arms crossed in towards your chest. Using
your ab muscles, bring your upper body off the ground as you open your arms
into goal post position, then slowly lower yourself back down to return to
starting position.

name: High Row
instructionStepsEn: Kneeling down on one leg and pulling cable down while driving elbow into the lats.

name: High-Incline Smith Machine Press
instructionStepsEn: Set the bench to a 45-60° incline. Touch the upper chest with the bar.

name: Battle Ropes
muscleGroup: Hamstrings · Glutes · Lats · Obliquus externus abdominis · Quads · Abs
instructionStepsEn: Hold the ends of the rope at arm's length in front of your hips with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and begin alternately raising and lowering each arm explosively.
Keep alternating arms for three to four sets of 1 to 2 minutes.

name: Devil’s Press
instructionStepsEn: Start with a dumbbell in each hand and perform a burpee, letting your chest touch the ground while holding the dumbbells.
Explosively jump your feet forward and swing the dumbbells between your legs.
Drive the dumbbells overhead in one continuous motion, locking out your arms.
Lower the dumbbells with control to return to the starting position and repeat

name: Bird Dog
instructionStepsEn: Begin on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips, keeping your spine neutral.
Extend your right arm forward and left leg backward simultaneously, keeping hips square.
Pause briefly at full extension while engaging your core and glutes.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side

name: Sliding Lateral Lunge
instructionStepsEn: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell close to your chest in goblet position. Place one foot on a slider, gliding disc, or towel. Keep your chest tall and core engaged. Slowly slide the foot outward to the side while bending the opposite knee, lowering your hips into a lateral lunge. Keep the working leg’s knee aligned with the toes and avoid letting it collapse inward. The non-working leg remains straight and slides smoothly along the floor. Push through the heel of the bent leg to return to the starting position while maintaining control of the kettlebell.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructionStepsEn: The seated dumbbell calf raise is a targeted exercise for strengthening the lower leg muscles. It follows the same movement pattern as the machine version: you place the weight on your knees, and by extending and flexing your ankles, you move the weight.

name: One Arm Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
instructionStepsEn: Set the pulley at the bottom of the cable machine and grab onto it without using any attachments. Extend the cable directly overhead.

While keeping your back straight and upper arm stationary, lower the cable behind your head until you feel a good stretch in your triceps, and then extend it back upward until your elbow is locked out.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructionStepsEn: Start with the dumbbells resting on your shoulders and squat down. Push
into standing and raise the dumbbells into an overhead position. Bring
the dumbbells back to your shoulders and repeat.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
instructionStepsEn:
Hinge at the hips:


Push your hips backward , keeping a slight bend in the knees (soft knees).
Lower the barbell along the front of your thighs/shins while maintaining a neutral spine .
Keep the bar close to your body .

name: Incline Shoulder Press Up
instructionStepsEn: Place your hands on the bench in a press up position
Push your chest away from the bench to separate your shoulder blades
Keeping your elbows straight , lower your chest towards the bench so your shoulder blades move closer together
Push your chest away from the bench again

name: Face pulls with yellow/green band
instructionStepsEn: Face pulls with band – standing horizontal pull. Grab the band at face height, pull elbows high and wide towards your face while squeezing shoulder blades together. Trains upper back, rear shoulders and improves posture.

name: Machine Hip Abduction
instructionStepsEn: Technique and Execution
Starting Position
Seated Positioning: Sit in the machine with back against the pad
Leg Placement: Inner thighs against the machine's padded resistance points
Adjust Machine: Set seat position to align your hip joint with the machine's pivot point
Movement Technique
Start with legs together or slightly pressed against the inner pads
Slowly push legs outward, spreading them apart
Move until maximum comfortable lateral range is reached
Pause briefly at the outer point of the movement
Slowly return to the starting position with controlled movement
Biomechanical Breakdown
Muscle Engagement
Primary Activation: Gluteus Medius (side hip muscle)
Stabilization: Engages core and lower back muscles
Functional Movement: Mimics lateral leg movement used in walking, sports, and daily activities
Benefits
Strength and Stability
Improves Hip Stability
Reduces Risk of Knee Injuries
Enhances Lateral Movement Capabilities
Targets Often-Neglected Muscle Groups

name: Abdominal Draw-In
instructionStepsEn: Lie
on your back with knees bent. Gently pull your belly button toward your
spine without moving your hips or holding your breath.

name: Frog Stretch
instructionStepsEn: Get on your hands and knees.
Widen your knees outwards, and drop to your elbows.
Without moving your elbows or knees, start to rock forwards and backwards, trying to get your bum closer to your feet.

name: Butterfly Superman
instructionStepsEn: Lie on stomach, intertwine fingers behind the head and start raising your head and raise elbows as far as they go.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing
instructionStepsEn: Belly breathing. Hand on chest stays still, hand on belly rises. 8-10 slow breaths.

name: Fire Hydrant Circles
instructionStepsEn: Fire Hydrant Circles
Part of: Limber 11
Source: Joe DeFranco
Prescription: 10 forward / 10 backward
Type: dynamic

name: Curl De Muñeca Con Barra
instructionStepsEn: Starting Position: Grip a bar with an overhand grip (palms facing up) at a width similar to your shoulders.

Position on the Bench: Kneel in front of a flat bench and rest the backs of your forearms on it. Your wrists and hands should extend slightly beyond the edge of the bench to allow for a full range of motion.

Eccentric Phase (Lowering): Lower the bar in a controlled manner by extending your wrists toward the floor. At the bottom of the movement, slightly spread your fingers to let the bar roll down a bit, maximizing the stretch.

Concentric Phase (Lift): First, close your fingers to secure the bar, then flex your wrists upward explosively but in a controlled manner, bringing the bar as high as possible. Strongly contract your forearms at the top position for one second.
Form: Keep your forearms firmly pressed against the bench throughout the exercise; only your wrists and fingers should move.

name: Side-Kick Breathing (Kickboard)
instructionStepsEn: Push off the wall on your side (not flat on your stomach), one arm extended forward holding the board or just extended, kicking continuously. Keep your head in a neutral position looking at the bottom of the pool, and when you need air, rotate your head sideways (one ear stays in the water, other faces up) to breathe, then rotate back to neutral. Swim a length like this, then repeat on the other side. This teaches the exact head position and rotation you'll use once full stroke breathing comes in.

name: Planche Lean Hold
instructionStepsEn: A straight-arm calisthenics static hold where you assume a plank position and lean the shoulders as far forward as possible past the wrists with protracted scapulae and a hollow body.
